fair_value_reason: I keep the mean of the revised forecasters. The agents now agree on 106M diluted shares, $150-175M horizon net debt, a $5.85-6.05 realized copper deck (checked against the ~4.5% realized-to-LME discount), Furnas on a 60% attributable risked basis (~$0.4B), and bottom-up EPS of ~$3.6-3.9. The blend is ~$37-38 on EV/EBITDA and P/E, with a 10-20% long-term-deck NAV leg at $26-30.5. My new points roughly offset: a mined-gold shortfall to ~45-50koz (-$0.7 to -1.4) and C1 risk against Q3-26 realized copper near $6.1 plus faster H2-26 deleveraging (+$0.5 to +1). supervisor_summary: After round two the five forecasts agree closely: fair value $35.2-36.5 (mean $35.8), median ~$37 and P(>=38) ~0.47, against a $37.87 close. My checks confirm their inputs. Ero realizes ~4.5% below LME, so the $5.85-6.05 deck matches Goldman's 2027 view; net debt was $452.7M and falling; 106M shares; and the 75-85kt / 80-90kt outlook still stands. Two quiet risks roughly offset the stronger Q3 copper price: C1 is running at $2.40, above guidance, and mined gold is only ~35koz/yr against the 50-60koz the models assume. I keep the mean ladder with low confidence and correct only the thesis-break reasoning ($23 is ~5x EBITDA at $5 copper, not ~3.8x), leaving the break at $23.
key_drivers: Copper: LME cash averaged $14,480/t (~$6.57/lb) in September 2026. Ero realizes ~4-5% below LME (Q2-26: $5.78 vs $6.04), so the agents' $5.85-6.05 realized deck implies ~$13,500-14,000/t LME, in line with Goldman's 2027 view. Each $0.50/lb is ~$85-90M of EBITDA, about $4-5/share at 6x.
Volume step-up per the filed outlook: 75-85kt Cu in 2027 and 80-90kt in 2028, dependent on the Pilar shaft handover in 2027. H1-26 copper output was 34.6kt, against 2026 guidance of 67.5-77.5kt.
Costs: C1 is running at $2.40/lb YTD, above 2026 guidance of $2.15-2.35, while agents use $2.25 for 2027. BRL collars ($450M, floor 5.40) run through Dec-2027.
Xavantina: mined gold is running at ~35koz/yr (Q2-26 8.7koz), against the 50-60koz 2027-28 outlook the agents' ~$130M gold EBITDA relies on. Historic concentrate sales end mid-2027.

Deleveraging: net debt was $452.7M at Q2-26 (leverage 0.8x), with capex peaking in 2026 and Q3 realized copper near $6.1. Horizon net debt of ~$100-200M and the start of capital returns underpin the base case.
